import unittest
from solution import AssetDraft, AssetPatch, AssetView, AssetRegistry


class AssetRegistryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_list_update_and_insertion_order(self):
        registry = AssetRegistry()
        first = AssetDraft("a", "Alpha", "IN", {"tags": ["one"]})
        second = AssetDraft("b", "Beta", "US", {})
        registry.add(first)
        registry.add(second)
        registry.update(AssetPatch("a", label="Alpha 2", metadata={"tags": ["two"]}))
        views = registry.list_all()
        self.assertEqual([v.code for v in views], ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(views[0], AssetView("a", "Alpha 2", "IN", {"tags": ["two"]}))
        self.assertEqual(views[1], AssetView("b", "Beta", "US", {}))

    def test_none_patch_fields_are_preserved(self):
        registry = AssetRegistry()
        registry.add(AssetDraft("a", "Alpha", "IN", {"x": 1}))
        registry.update(AssetPatch("a"))
        self.assertEqual(registry.list_all(), [AssetView("a", "Alpha", "IN", {"x": 1})])

    def test_deep_copy_independence_in_all_directions(self):
        metadata = {"nested": {"values": [1]}}
        draft = AssetDraft("a", "Alpha", "IN", metadata)
        registry = AssetRegistry()
        registry.add(draft)
        metadata["nested"]["values"].append(2)
        draft.metadata["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        first_view = registry.list_all()[0]
        self.assertEqual(first_view.metadata, {"nested": {"values": [1]}})
        first_view.metadata["nested"]["values"].append(4)
        second_view = registry.list_all()[0]
        self.assertEqual(second_view.metadata, {"nested": {"values": [1]}})
        self.assertIsNot(first_view, second_view)
        patch_metadata = {"items": ["x"]}
        patch = AssetPatch("a", metadata=patch_metadata)
        registry.update(patch)
        patch_metadata["items"].append("y")
        patch.metadata["items"].append("z")
        self.assertEqual(registry.list_all()[0].metadata, {"items": ["x"]})

    def test_duplicate_missing_and_remove(self):
        registry = AssetRegistry()
        registry.add(AssetDraft("a", "Alpha", "IN", {}))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            registry.add(AssetDraft("a", "Again", "US", {}))
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            registry.update(AssetPatch("missing", label="X"))
        self.assertFalse(registry.remove("missing"))
        self.assertTrue(registry.remove("a"))
        self.assertFalse(registry.remove("a"))
        self.assertEqual(registry.list_all(), [])

    def test_invalid_object_types(self):
        registry = AssetRegistry()
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            registry.add({"code": "a"})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            registry.update(AssetDraft("a", "A", "IN", {}))
        for code in (None, 3):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                registry.remove(code)

    def test_invalid_fields_on_dataclasses(self):
        constructors = [
            lambda: AssetDraft("", "A", "IN", {}),
            lambda: AssetDraft("a", "", "IN", {}),
            lambda: AssetDraft("a", "A", "", {}),
            lambda: AssetDraft("a", "A", "IN", []),
            lambda: AssetPatch("", label="A"),
            lambda: AssetPatch("a", label=""),
            lambda: AssetPatch("a", region=""),
            lambda: AssetPatch("a", metadata=[]),
            lambda: AssetView("a", "A", "IN", []),
        ]
        for constructor in constructors:
            with self.subTest(constructor=constructor):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    constructor()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
